killedBy: live status announcements (issue #629) WRITES the live region once across sixty identical pushes, not sixty times
why: Removes the coalescing guard, so the live region is rewritten on EVERY status push -- and `refreshTopbar` pushes one per frame, so that is sixty rewrites a second while nothing changes. A screen reader reacts to the mutation, not to the content, so the result is continuous narration of a sentence that has not changed: the speech-spam failure this feature is most likely to produce, and the one issue #629's criterion 6 names. Invisible to an assertion on the final text, which sixty identical writes leave looking correct -- the killing case counts DOM mutations through a MutationObserver instead.
